description: Didomi Web SDK loader on sdk.privacy-center.org/{Public API Key}/loader.js. The Public API Key rides in the path. Core and UI SDK files under /sdk/ are not contracted. api.privacy-center.org events are not contracted.

params.name: api_key
params.description: It is the Didomi Public API Key. Didomi documents the loader as sdk.privacy-center.org/{Public API Key}/loader.js.
params.fix_hint: Copy the embed from Didomi Console so the path is /{Public API Key}/loader.js.

params.name: country
params.description: Didomi loader overrides use an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

params.name: region
params.description: Didomi uses the country subdivision code on loader requests.

params.name: target_type
params.description: Didomi documents notice as the consent-notice loader target type.

params.name: target
params.description: Didomi documents target as the consent notice identifier.

rules.message: A consent notice target requires its notice identifier.
